glosses: to introduce (to cause someone to be acquainted with someone else)

examples.text: Pani Leila przedstawiła Marcina swojej przyjaciółce, pani Minie.
examples.translation: Ms. Leila introduced Marcin to her friend Ms. Mina.
examples.english: Ms. Leila introduced Marcin to her friend Ms. Mina.
